pointmaze_port_cap_rule: min(1 chip-hour, 0.10*authorized effective campaign budget); includes compile/retry
statistical_unit: prompt; average paired seed bundle within prompt first
diagnostic_hypothesis: Between-prompt variance in paired policy differences makes more prompt coverage more efficient than more seeds, at fixed full-policy rollout cost.
diagnostic_prediction: Variance(P,S) = B/P + W/(P*S); estimate B and W by random-effects moments without assuming equal seed and prompt value.
history_scope: all input data are DEVELOPMENT; no new selection or confirmation observations
missing_data: refuse nonrectangular/missing/nonfinite paired blocks; retain all failures; do not impute
IR_inference: descriptive cluster bootstrap and Gaussian precision approximation; no known support bound or sequential certificate
planning_secondary: geodesic reduction if supported by simulator
planning_policies: exact four hashes from original Ultra manifest; no tuning
planning_information_gate: must observe paired policy discordance and forecast adequate precision; pooled success alone is insufficient
